facts.name: editor heading 1 font-size
facts.cite: style-*.css custom property `--editor-h1-font-size`. The editor's own heading scale: the property name states the level, so it is self-describing rather than a frequency guess. Six levels exist (h1..h6), which corrected my initial assumption of three.

facts.name: editor block spacing
facts.cite: style-*.css custom property `--editor-block-spacing`, in the `:root, .sx-16acs0i` group. That group is the only definition attached to :root, so it is the default; other classes override the same property for scoped contexts (block-spacing has four values, line-height eleven), and citing one of those would be a guess about which context applies.

facts.name: editor block spacing small
facts.cite: style-*.css custom property `--editor-block-spacing-small`, defined as calc(.375 * var(--editor-block-spacing)). With the :root block-spacing of 1rem that is 0.375rem. A derived value, so both legs are cited: the multiplier and the base.
